newsitem.title: UK: Soft oils firm, palm oil consolidating in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Soft oils firm, palm oil consolidating in Europe.

text.p: A strong dollar against major European currencies supported soft oils on Friday morning while palm oil appeared to be consolidating.
Soft oils rose despite the lower close on Chicago futures on Thursday mainly on the strength of dollar.
Palm oil was little changed as the market tried to consolidate around current levels after recent losses.
On a quiet market Dutch soy oil sellers were 0.50 guilders up while rape oil was 0.75 to 1.50 guilders higher.
Rape oil's premium over soy oil at midday, based on sellers' prices, was 1.75 guilders to par against one to 0.75 guilders at Thursday's close.
Crude palm oil cif Europe was offered unchanged to $2.50 up after Feb traded at $557.50 and Apr/Jun at $550 a tonne cif in early business.
RBD palm oil was unchanged to $2.50 down after Feb traded at $557.50 while olein was $2.50 up after Apr/Jun traded at $570 a tonne fob Malaysian ports.
On a tradeless lauric oil sector coconut oil was $17.50 to $7.50 up and palmkernel oil unchanged to $7.50 higher.
